sloka: तत: प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा भरद्वाजं पुन:पुन: ।भरतस्तु ययौ श्रीमानयोध्यां सह मन्त्रिभि: ॥ २.११३.१९॥
transliteration: tata: pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā bharadvājaṁ puna:puna: ।bharatastu yayau śrīmānayodhyāṁ saha mantribhi: ॥ 2.113.19॥

translations.english: Then illustrious Bharata circumambulated the sage several times in homage before he set out for Ayodhya with his counsellors.
